role: LLM-driven maintenance engine that proposes MEANS edges for ungrounded words during consolidation cycles.
detail: Examines unprocessed GroundingFailureRecord nodes, deduplicates by triggering word, calls Claude to propose primitive-symbol mappings, validates proposals against graph state, and commits valid edges at confidence=0.2. Key classes: GroundingMaintenanceEngine (async coordinator), GroundingProposal (immutable result), GroundingMaintenanceReport (cycle outcome). Engine lazily initializes AsyncAnthropic client (model=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, max_tokens=1024). Validation checks word/primitive existence, weight bounds [0.0,1.0], and deduplicates existing MEANS edges. Committed edges carry INFERENCE provenance, zero exposure/reliability (incremented during conversation), proposed_at timestamp, and guardian_confirmed=False. Fire-and-forget on LLM failure—never blocks consolidation. Respects CANON A.12 (no NLP in cognition path) and A.11 (INFERENCE provenance). Constants: _MAX_FAILURES_PER_CYCLE=50, _MAX_WORDS_PER_PROMPT=20, _PRIMITIVE_NAME_TO_ID maps bare names to node IDs.
gotchas: LLM client lazily initialized and reused across cycles (cached in _llm_client); markdown fence stripping in JSON parse (lines 354-358); exception swallowed in edge-existence check (line 440) to allow idempotent save_edge; failures marked processed even if no proposals generated (line 241)—prevents re-reading but may hide upstream issues
